openai_fallback_structured_denial.pre_fix: scripts/openclaw-configure-shared-model-pool.sh registered openai/gpt-5.6-sol and openai/gpt-5.5 with agentRuntime.id='codex'. In OpenClaw 2026.7.1, agentRuntime.id='codex' selects the Codex app-server harness, which unconditionally rejects structured-extraction (tools.deny=['*'], tools.exec={'security':'deny','ask':'always'}) with 'Codex app-server local execution is not available when tools.exec.mode=deny'.
openai_fallback_structured_denial.post_fix: openai/gpt-5.6-sol and openai/gpt-5.5 now use agentRuntime.id='openclaw' so OpenClaw's embedded HTTP/OAuth runtime resolves the product main-profile OpenAI/Codex OAuth credentials stored in the native main-agent auth-profile store on openclaw-data without spawning codex app-server and without importing or symlinking worker/delegated .codex CLI homes, while preserving tools.deny=['*'] and tools.exec={'security':'deny','ask':'always'}.

anthropic_primary_api_and_workspace_bind.pre_fix: scripts/openclaw-configure-shared-model-pool.sh registered anthropic/claude-opus-4-8 with agentRuntime.id='claude-cli' (subscription CLI backend), and neither scripts/openclaw_isolated_model_bootstrap.py nor the formal dev deploy/rollback workflow jobs bound ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and anthropic-workspace-id.
anthropic_primary_api_and_workspace_bind.post_fix: anthropic/claude-opus-4-8 now uses agentRuntime.id='openclaw'. On the persistent openclaw-data volume, scripts/openclaw-configure-shared-model-pool.sh persists the non-secret literal ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID value into models.providers.anthropic.headers['anthropic-workspace-id'] (deleting ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID from the config set subprocess env so restoreEnvVarRefs never writes an unresolved '${ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID}' reference on disk), preserving rollback compatibility with incumbent 4aacd76ca2425c3e12dff005668ffc8fa48dc17f. In isolated CI qualification, scripts/openclaw_isolated_model_bootstrap.py applies ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_BATCH with '${ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID}'. docker-compose.yml passes PANTHEON_OPENCLAW_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -> ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and PANTHEON_OPENCLAW_ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID -> ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID into openclaw-gateway, and .github/workflows/nonprod-deploy.yml binds DEV_OPENCLAW_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, DEV_OPENCLAW_ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID, and DEV_OPENCLAW_CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN across deploy-dev, coordinate-dev-release, and isolated-l12-provider-qualification.

adapter_structured_routing.change: services/openclaw-gateway-adapter/assistant_openclaw_provider.py defaults invoke_structured agent_id to STRUCTURED_AGENT_ID ('structured-extraction'), rejects non-structured agent_id with 422 OPENCLAW_STRUCTURED_AGENT_NOT_ALLOWED, omits X-OpenClaw-Model when model is None so the Gateway executes primary anthropic/claude-opus-4-8 with automatic fallback to ['openai/gpt-5.6-sol', 'openai/gpt-5.5'], forwards X-OpenClaw-Model when an explicit model override is requested, and does not propagate output['active_model'] because OpenClaw /v1/responses returns 'openclaw/<agentId>' in response.model rather than the resolved provider/model slot.

guide_reconciliation.change: integrations/openclaw/model-pool-and-persona-routing.md documents the native main-profile OpenAI/Codex OAuth routing on agentRuntime.id='openclaw' for openai/gpt-5.6-sol and openai/gpt-5.5, primary anthropic/claude-opus-4-8 API + workspace header routing on agentRuntime.id='openclaw' with literal workspace persistence for rollback safety, and the quota distinction between Anthropic API/workspace (claude-opus-4-8), Claude CLI subscription/token (claude-sonnet-4-6), and main-profile OpenAI/Codex OAuth without worker credential import.

pinned_gateway_2026_7_1_reproduction.method: Local ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw:2026.7.1 gateway container against a local deterministic synthetic HTTP stub with synthetic main-profile auth-profiles.json on a disposable Docker volume. Scope boundary: this reproduces container config, agentRuntime dispatch, tool denial, header forwarding, primary-to-fallback failover, and OLD4aac rollback config validity locally; it is not live external provider/OAuth acceptance, hosted FULL deployment, or 12-loop closure.
